# Temple Scroll Column 52 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 52 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**52:1** And behold, he has placed deeds of words, saying: I did not find in your daughter signs-of-virginity; and these are the signs-of-virginity of my daughter — and they shall spread out the garment before the elders of the city.

**52:2** And the elders of that city shall take the man and discipline him.

**52:3** And they shall fine him one hundred shekels of silver and give them to the father of the young-woman, because he brought out an evil name upon a virgin of Israel; and she shall be to him for a wife, and he is not able to send her away all his days.

**52:4** But if this word was true, and signs-of-virginity were not found for the young-woman,

**52:5** then they shall bring out the young-woman to the entrance of the house of her father, and the men of her city shall stone her with stones and she shall die, because she did a disgraceful-thing in Israel, to act-as-a-harlot in the house of her father; and you shall burn out the evil from your midst.

**52:6** If a man is found lying with a woman who is married to a husband, then both of them shall die — the man who lay with the woman, and the woman; and you shall burn out the evil from Israel.

**52:7** If a young-woman who is a virgin is betrothed to a man, and a man finds her in the city and lies with her,

**52:8** then you shall bring both of them out to the gate of that city and stone them with stones and they shall die — the young-woman because she did not cry out in the city, and the man because he humbled the wife of his neighbor; and you shall burn out the evil from your midst.

**52:9** But if in the field the man finds the betrothed young-woman, and the man seizes her and lies with her, then only the man who lay with her shall die.

**52:10** And to the young-woman you shall not do a thing; there is not to the young-woman a sin worthy-of-death, for as when a man rises against his neighbor and murders him — a soul — thus is this matter.

**52:11** For in the field he found her; the betrothed young-woman cried out, and there was no one to save her.

**52:12** If a man finds a young-woman who is a virgin and who is not betrothed, and he seizes her and lies with her, and they are found,

**52:13** then the man who lay with her shall give to the father of the young-woman fifty shekels of silver, and she shall be to him for a wife, on account of the fact that he humbled her; he is not able to send her away all his days.

**52:14** A man shall not take the wife of his father and shall not uncover the skirt of his father.

**52:15** One who is crushed of testicle or cut of male-member shall not come into the assembly of the LORD.

**52:16** A bastard shall not come into the assembly of the LORD; even to the tenth generation none of his shall come into the assembly of the LORD.

---

*EMET notes: Column 52 continues Deuteronomy 22:17-23:2, preserving the divine first-person voice. "Signs-of-virginity" (betulim) maintained as compound. "Disgraceful-thing" (nevalah) rendered literally. "Crushed of testicle" and "cut of male-member" preserve the Hebrew anatomical specificity of Deut 23:1. "Bastard" (mamzer) — one born of a forbidden union.*
